Directory research 2026-10-04: Check the linked venue: the band's own schedule shows no Knights of Columbus Hall, Patchogue date; its only Knights of Columbus show is a Feb 13, 2027 dinner dance at Infant Jesus Parish, 110 Myrtle Ave, Port Jefferson. The Patchogue event may be mis-matched, or may come from a different source (e.g. The Dance Calendar). No official Facebook, Instagram or YouTube found; YouTube clips exist on members' or fans' channels only. Several gallery images look digitally composited (studio portraits and a stage with a very large crowd); they are the group's own promo images, but the owner may prefer a plain performance photo.
description: A four-man doo-wop vocal harmony group from the New York area that sings hits of the 1950s, 60s and 70s in matching sequined jackets. They play concerts, dinner dances, sock hops, street fairs and private parties on Long Island, in New York City and in New Jersey.
